from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
base='9d52bb31992ab0e867e6816e449c4d26cce9136b'
target=repo/'tests/test_ats_adapter_contract.py'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base or git('rev-parse','origin/main')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
if git('status','--porcelain','--',str(target.relative_to(repo))):raise SystemExit('TARGET_DIRTY')
s=target.read_text()
marker='''@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_apply_csv_continues_from_missing_material_to_real_chromium_review(
    page, resume_file, profile, tmp_path
):'''
replacement='''@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.parametrize("name,adapter_cls,expected", ADAPTERS)
async def test_apply_csv_continues_from_missing_material_to_real_chromium_review(
    page, resume_file, profile, tmp_path, name, adapter_cls, expected
):'''
assert s.count(marker)==1,'TEST_ANCHOR_CHANGED'
s=s.replace(marker,replacement)
start=s.index('async def test_apply_csv_continues_from_missing_material_to_real_chromium_review(')
pre=s[:start];post=s[start:]
post=post.replace('url="http://127.0.0.1/fixture/greenhouse-review"','url=f"http://127.0.0.1/fixture/{name}-review"',1)
post=post.replace('html=(FIXTURE_DIR/"greenhouse.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")','html=(FIXTURE_DIR/f"{name}.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")',1)
post=post.replace('"source":"greenhouse"','"source":name')
post=post.replace('context=context_for(page,"greenhouse",profile,resume_file,','context=context_for(page,name,profile,resume_file,',1)
post=post.replace('outcome=await GreenhouseAdapter().run(','outcome=await adapter_cls().run(',1)
post=post.replace('''    assert len(actual)==1 and actual[0].status is OutcomeStatus.REVIEW_READY
    assert project.call_count==2''','''    assert len(actual)==1 and actual[0].status is OutcomeStatus.REVIEW_READY
    assert expected <= set(actual[0].details["review"]["filled_fields"])
    assert actual[0].details["review"]["uploaded_files"] == ["resume"]
    assert project.call_count==2''',1)
target.write_text(pre+post)
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','-rs','--tb=short','tests/test_ats_adapter_contract.py','-k','apply_csv_continues_from_missing_material_to_real_chromium_review'],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=210)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
print('RESULT',p.returncode,o[-5700:],e[-1000:],flush=True)
if p.returncode or '4 passed' not in o or 'skipped' in o:raise SystemExit('ACCEPTANCE_FAILED_NO_COMMIT')
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','tests/test_ats_adapter_contract.py'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','test: cover mixed-queue Chromium Review across four ATS adapters'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','origin','main'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=90)
print('VERIFIED_PUSH',git('rev-parse','HEAD'),flush=True)
